book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Isakva Yakopm Kalelm Wolaihangana Dom Nnolindam.
Doa Isak ona, Yakop prora, pronamba, aral omnana, lehra yimba proi, beswonam hello, manam yimba ungundongorinimba huiva vravav Kenan petharava.
Owai, yeoa os veo, gao eindpevindam Betuelindam Mesopotamia petharam. Wo nnopovna molm vrao di, mongom Lapanna molm.
Wo Sesoa mendekli yem kolvrowol vera, yem ongapevm, wo otolva eva yenamba si mindnam avav. Wo sewonamba indhanamba mindnam si os yemba ningthivra, simbel kanamba luhunna Yakopva.

Sesoa ten keknamangas lohvm, heoa os yemoa beswonam vewol vera, ten nemet Apraham venavnam, wo si yimba hona pethamba vaohothovav, memba yimba lohmana vevpa, Sesoava nemetva Aprahamba indthoamnanamba, omnana, si yetindiva honam vaohuthuivav.
Wo osoa aral kalelmba wolaihangana nnolindam Mesopotamia petharam oklam. Nnolva nomba Lapan Betuelna ombol. Betuelva nomba Aramnindrini lohna.
Esauva Henga Ongam Mongom Vrana Hevtindiongorinim.
Doa Esauva hellenamba os, aramba doa kalelm kolvrelmonamba awothona, wolaihanga nnolindam oklapetharam. Omnana, manam yimba Kenanongorinimba huiva vravav, owai, di vrao nnopovina.
Esauva eva hellenamba, boaslava doa oklapetharam gana aralavalna moara.
Doa os himba nengna, kana aramba ovov hona ungundongomba.
Wo noinda himba Ismaelindam ganamba, di vrana hena molm nihilva Mahalat. Mahalatva nomba Nepaiotna etel, Ismaelva nomba Aprahamna ombol. Seilva Esauva ungundongorini samblam dambtna.
Yakopva Monara Lina, Inungpunung Vena.
Doa Yakop aralnamini Bersepa kembellini venamba, nnolindam gana Harandam.
Doa okombava helgang vovhoavna, monara avhoa. Sinim ona lithana, wo kuva holothona honsra sena.
Doa inungpunung vevna, os nonglana, yimundva kuethalohvongov, pethara veiva, sena Sesoainda. Wo Sesoana ovsongolnindva nosra ahalapiha vevna.

Yawem eva nonglana, di murapeta lohvna. Doa he omnana, kava Yawe, kava Sesoa lohv, ten arapevi eindpevi sembayang evelohmanavnam. Yimba memba livpa hona petharava, si yemba kava kovorahunvav yem, yetindim.
Wo yetindiva si os mindnam avav, oi somovtov. Wo hena pethava mindnam si os luhuku vinvav, nohalm nohalm nohalm. Wo yimba kananapopol indkolam monglam beswonam vewol vivav, hindtindim hindtindim.

Manam yimba maivethavav, yimba nosharava gavrava, kava yemongo engavav, eva kekalvho vremnavav, wo yemba kava henga si waiprovav hona petharam. Wo yemba kava nombolvhoavavmoa, verava, kava si yemba wohvenavav, os men kav oim.
Doa Yakopva nov vawovna, ona tanam Yaweva hona pethara av, nemetva kava titnam ana.
Doa pem vevna, henga ona, kava pem vev hona petharava, memba Sesoana deuvpa lohv, honamba yimundva Sesoainda kuethalohvongov.

Doa sieunumbulnam phonamba, wo honmba nomba kutumriniva indund vilindthoana, osm si maivethavavmoa, memba kava nonglaiva mana vemamba inungpunungrava. Doa himba olivpol no honsra sovhona, ona, memba honmba Sesoam wohlohmanav. Doa hev nomba pethava os sevrana Betel, osm ovna Sesoana deuvpa.
Nemetva hona petharava kembelva dihelna, Lus kembel os uvna.
Doa Yakopva Yawemba os osahmanavna, yeoa kamoa beswonam waingavm kavna nnoinam, wo kam dembraohvm inne eva kayen,
wo kam henga kavna araindam beswonam waingavm. Yimba osva vevrava, yemba kava wohlohmanavav,
wo hona honda si kava yemba sembayang velohmanavav, wo mana vemamba yimba kamba dembrahovrava, wo yemba kava eunumbulva henga dembrahovra.
